WITH group_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    st.riskeval,
    AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) as group_avg_rate
  FROM scans s
  JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.spanmin > 0
  GROUP BY st.riskeval
),
benchmark_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg_rate) as benchmark_rate
  FROM group_rates
),
above_benchmark_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    gr.group_avg_rate,
    bc.benchmark_rate,
    gr.group_avg_rate - bc.benchmark_rate as margin
  FROM group_rates gr
  CROSS JOIN benchmark_calc bc
  WHERE gr.group_avg_rate > bc.benchmark_rate
)
SELECT 
  AVG(group_avg_rate) as avg_rate,
  AVG(margin) as avg_margin
FROM above_benchmark_groups

assumptions.assumption: Only scans with spanmin > 0 are included in rate calculations, to avoid division by zero and invalid (zero or negative) scan durations.
